name: Google Workspace · Keep people in step
description: On Landbright's identity and group-member events: an active person of the Google domain gets their Google account created or updated (names, department, title, manager, Landbright's id) and their Google groups set from the map in Plan; a deactivated person is suspended and signed out of Google. Pre-hires wait for their start date; agents get no account. One flow for every event, so a burst for one person converges. Needs the landbright and gdirectory plugins (spec 009).

parameters.events: identity.created, identity.activated, identity.updated, identity.deactivated, identity.reactivated, group.member_added, group.member_removed
